B: No, I (2)_____. What is it?
G: It's a special day (3)_____ April 22. People take (4)_____ in a global event.
B: I see. What (5)_____ they do?
G: They do many things. For example, some people turn (6)_____ the lights (7)_____ ten minutes.
B: Wow! But how can that (8)_____ the environment?
G: It can save a lot of (9)_____. Also, it can (10)_____ greenhouse gases. Why don't we (11)_____ part in the event?
B: That's a (12)_____ idea. Let's do it.

이 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 쓰시오.

B: Hi, Bora. What are you (1)_____ to do this weekend?
G: I'm (2)_____ to go to a zero waste shop. Do you know about zero waste shops?
B: No, I don't. Please (3)_____ me about them.
G: They don't (4)_____ items in containers, so you can reduce (5)_____. Why (6)_____ you come with me?
B: That sounds great! What can I (7)_____ there?
G: You can buy a lot of (8)_____. For example, they have bags, shampoo, and some snacks.
B: I see. I'm going to (9)_____ shampoo.
G: You should (10)_____ your own container, then. You can (11)_____ the shampoo in it.
B: Okay.
